name: Cerebrolysin
description: Mixture of small peptides and amino acids taken from pig brain protein; not a single molecule

note.text: Stroke: probably little or no difference in death; more non-fatal serious events. Dementia: very low-quality evidence.

bullets: Some of its proteins **occur naturally** in the human brain
**Nerve-protecting and nerve-growth** effects in preclinical (animal) stroke models
**In people,** how it might act is not settled
Many randomized trials, mostly stroke and dementia
CASTA (1,070): no difference on main outcome
Several trials funded by the maker

practical.routes: Injection into muscle or vein, or IV infusion (Austrian leaflet)
practical.soldAs: Not approved in the US; approved medicine in Austria
practical.monitored: Stroke and dementia scales; serious adverse events

regulatory.text: Not approved; not on compounding lists

references: Cochrane, Cerebrolysin for acute ischaemic stroke, Oct 2023
Stroke, CASTA trial of Cerebrolysin in acute stroke, Mar 2012
